text.tspan: Bow to the right (swipe the picture sideways on a phone). Men on watch work the weather deck and the rigging; the rest sleep, eat or idle below. Tired men work slowly, so give the sleepers good berths.
11 men at work · relieved in 1 h 00 min by the quarter watch

Serve a tot of rum to every hand: lifts spirits for a while

text.tspan: Days without fresh food · limes · rum

g.data-label: Pumps: Auto starts when water is gaining

text.tspan: Caulk the seams and patch the hull
Jobs use up spares as the work goes on. Timber, canvas, cordage and pitch are all sold in port. Work aloft stops in a fresh wind, and the carpenter only works while he is on watch.
Not in port. Come to anchor within a mile and a half of a town to buy and sell (Bridgetown is 0 miles off).
Salt fish per 100 lb: Bridgetown 27s, Castries 23s, St John's 27s, Kingstown 23s, Basseterre 23s. The plantation islands pay most.
